name: Bore Packing and Core cut Treatment
item_name: Bore Packing and Core cut Treatment
description:
Drainpipes and Core Cut Treatment – Step by Step Process

Step 1: Surface Preparation
	•	Clean and prepare the surface using a wire brush or grinder.
	•	Wash the surface with water to remove all dust and loose particles.

Step 2: Packing the Core Cut Junction
	•	Pack the core cut junction with non-shrink free flow cementitious grout – Dr. Fixit Pidigrout 10M.

Step 3: Grout Mixing
	•	Mix the ready-to-use grout with water at a water-to-powder ratio (w/p) of 0.13 – 0.15.
	•	Adjust the ratio depending on the flowability required.
	•	Use a paddle mixer to ensure proper mixing.

Step 4: Grout Application
	•	Provide the necessary shuttering and support.
	•	Pour the mixed grout into the core cut area.

Step 5: Initial Setting
	•	Allow the grout to set for 24 hours.

Step 6: Curing
	•	Perform moist curing for 5 days.

Step 7: Sealing Remaining Area
	•	Seal the remaining area with Feviseal HY 100 PU Sealant.

Step 8: Pipe Area Treatment
	•	Dress the area around the pipes with Bathseal Tape in wet-on-wet condition.
	•	Apply Pidifin 2K before placing the tape.
